items.title: Mike Evans: Ruled out for remainder of MNF
items.text:
Evans (Achilles) has been ruled out for the remainder of Monday night's game against the Commanders, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

items.title: Mike Evans: Questionable to return Monday
items.text:

items.title: Mike Evans: Heads to locker room Monday
items.text:
Evans headed to the locker room in the second quarter of Monday night's game against the Commanders with an apparent Achilles injury, Harrison Rich of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.

items.title: Terry McLaurin: Carted off with knee injury
items.text:
McLaurin left Monday night's game against the 49ers in the first quarter with a left knee injury, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.
